content.name: Quarterstaff of the Acrobat
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

While holding this weapon, you can cause it to emit green {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} out to 10 feet, either as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} or after you roll {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52}, or you can extinguish the light as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.

While holding this weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod (for ease of storage) or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff; the weapon will elongate only as far as the surrounding space allows.
In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties.

entries.name: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)
entries: While holding this weapon, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|SRD52}) checks.

entries.name: Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)
entries: When you are hit by an attack while holding the weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to twirl the weapon around you, gaining a +5 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you. You can't use this property again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only)
entries: This weapon has {@itemProperty T|SRD52|Thrown} with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.
